author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content:
Hi warga threads!

We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project

Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out.

We're looking for artists that draws
- Anime / manga style illustrations
- Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration
- Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork
- Semi-realistic illustrations
- and any other art styles

Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

Follow-up from author (same thread): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Thank you.

Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k directly.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy author seeking map designer and character illustrator
content:
Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both.

Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me.

See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each.

Author follow-ups in thread: For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration. Book is lighter fantasy but wants art that feels grounded and lifelike. Open to different styles. Bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Needs portraits for the time being; if someone pins the art style for the series it can turn into more. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open.

Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.
